reason.en: The committee gave several reasons for delaying the final decision.
reason.zh: 委员会给出了推迟最终决定的几项理由。

reason.en: He doubted the reason behind the committee's sudden withdrawal.
reason.zh: 他怀疑委员会突然撤回背后的原因。

reason.en: Human reason has always struggled to explain the origins of consciousness.
reason.zh: 人类理性历来难以解释意识的起源。

requirement.en: Applicants must meet every requirement listed in the admission criteria.
requirement.zh: 申请人必须满足招生标准中列出的每一项要求。

requirement.en: The journal's primary requirement is that the study be reproducible.
requirement.zh: 该期刊的首要要求是研究必须可复现。

requirement.en: Access to clean water remains a basic requirement for public health.
requirement.zh: 获得清洁水源仍然是公共卫生的基本要求。

research.en: Recent research suggests that moderate exercise improves memory in older adults.
research.zh: 近期研究表明，适度运动能改善老年人的记忆能力。

research.en: The research on urban transport was published by the ministry last spring.
research.zh: 关于城市交通的研究由该部于去年春天发布。

research.en: Funding for early-career research remains limited across most disciplines.
research.zh: 在大多数学科中，职业早期阶段的研究经费仍然有限。

result.en: The result of the experiment contradicted the researchers' initial hypothesis.
result.zh: 实验结果与研究人员的初步假设相矛盾。

result.en: As a result, the company withdrew the product from the market.
result.zh: 结果，该公司将该产品撤出了市场。

result.en: The results clearly indicate a need for stronger safeguards in the process.
result.zh: 研究结果清楚地表明，该流程需要更严格的保障措施。

role.en: Teachers play a central role in developing students' critical thinking skills.
role.zh: 教师在培养学生的批判性思维能力方面发挥着核心作用。

role.en: The role of the laboratory in this project has not been clearly defined.
role.zh: 该实验室在这个项目中的角色尚未被明确规定。

role.en: Her role as chief advisor changed the direction of the entire study.
role.zh: 她作为首席顾问的角色改变了整个研究方向。

rule.en: Under the new rule, all researchers must register their data publicly.
rule.zh: 根据新规定，所有研究人员必须公开登记其数据。

rule.en: The first rule of the workshop is to keep the discussion focused.
rule.zh: 研讨会的第一条规则是保持讨论聚焦。

rule.en: Economic rules rarely anticipate the side effects of rapid technological change.
rule.zh: 经济规则很少能预见快速技术变革带来的副作用。

section.en: The final section of the paper summarizes the main findings clearly.
section.zh: 论文的最后一部分清楚地总结了主要发现。

section.en: The library's reference section contains the complete collection of journals.
section.zh: 图书馆的参考区收录了全套期刊。

section.en: Each section of the questionnaire was pilot-tested before the main survey.
section.zh: 在正式调查开始前，问卷的每个部分都经过了预测试。

source.en: Citing the original source is essential in academic writing.
source.zh: 引用原始来源在学术写作中至关重要。

source.en: Solar energy remains a promising source of electricity for remote regions.
source.zh: 太阳能仍是偏远地区一个有前景的电力来源。

source.en: The researcher consulted several sources before publishing her conclusions.
source.zh: 该研究人员在发表结论前查阅了若干资料来源。

standard.en: The university has adopted a new standard for evaluating teaching quality.
standard.zh: 该大学已采用评估教学质量的新标准。

standard.en: Their work meets the standard set by international regulatory agencies.
standard.zh: 他们的工作达到了国际监管机构设定的标准。

standard.en: The laboratory's accreditation certificate confirms compliance with the highest standard.
standard.zh: 该实验室的认证证书证实其符合最高标准。

step.en: The first step in the process is to identify the main problem.
step.zh: 该流程的第一步是确定主要问题。

step.en: Taking one step at a time makes the transition far less overwhelming.
step.zh: 一步一步来会让过渡变得轻松得多。

step.en: The committee agreed that further steps would be taken next month.
step.zh: 委员会同意下个月将采取进一步措施。

strategy.en: The company adopted a new strategy to expand into emerging markets.
strategy.zh: 公司制定了进军新兴市场的新战略。

strategy.en: Our research strategy combines field interviews with archival document analysis.
strategy.zh: 我们的研究策略将实地访谈与档案文献分析结合起来。

strategy.en: A clear communication strategy reduced confusion among the project team.
strategy.zh: 清晰的沟通策略减少了项目团队中的困惑。

structure.en: The structure of the report follows a logical progression from theory to practice.
structure.zh: 报告的结构遵循从理论到实践的逻辑推进。

structure.en: Changes in the organizational structure improved communication between departments.
structure.zh: 组织结构的变化改善了部门之间的沟通。

structure.en: Understanding the social structure of the village requires careful historical comparison.
structure.zh: 理解这个村庄的社会结构需要仔细地进行历史比较。

technique.en: This technique allows researchers to measure the effect with minimal error.
technique.zh: 这一技术使研究人员能以极小的误差测量效果。

technique.en: Interviewing participants is a reliable technique for gathering qualitative data.
technique.zh: 访谈参与者是收集定性数据的一种可靠方法。

technique.en: The painting technique was passed down through several generations of the family.
technique.zh: 这种绘画技法在这个家族中传了好几代人。

term.en: In academic writing, a precise term conveys meaning more efficiently than plain language.
term.zh: 在学术写作中，精确的术语比普通语言更有效地传达含义。

term.en: The term 'sustainability' has been defined in many different ways.
term.zh: 「可持续性」一词有多种不同的定义。

term.en: All participants agreed to the standard terms of the consent form.
term.zh: 所有参与者都同意了知情同意书的标准条款。

theory.en: The theory explains why certain patterns appear repeatedly in the data.
theory.zh: 该理论解释了为什么某些模式在数据中反复出现。

theory.en: Darwin's theory of evolution transformed the way biologists study species.
theory.zh: 达尔文的进化论改变了生物学家研究物种的方式。

theory.en: In my opinion, the theory is promising but still requires extensive testing.
theory.zh: 在我看来，这个理论很有前景，但仍需广泛检验。

value.en: The market value of the collection has doubled over the past decade.
value.zh: 这批藏品的市值在过去 10 年翻了一番。

value.en: Research ethics treats every participant's informed consent as having intrinsic value.
value.zh: 研究伦理认为每位参与者的知情同意具有内在价值。

value.en: Investors increasingly judge a company by the value it creates.
value.zh: 投资者越来越以企业创造的价值来评判它。

variable.en: Temperature is the only variable that changed significantly during the trial.
variable.zh: 温度是试验期间唯一发生显著变化的变量。

variable.en: The model assumes that each variable influences the final outcome directly.
variable.zh: 该模型假定每个变量都直接影响最终结果。

variable.en: Researchers must control every variable before drawing firm conclusions.
variable.zh: 研究人员在得出确切结论前必须控制每个变量。

abstract.en: The abstract explains the main argument in only two hundred words.
abstract.zh: 摘要仅用 200 个单词就阐明了主要论点。

abstract.en: Abstract principles are difficult to apply in concrete financial decisions.
abstract.zh: 抽象的原则很难应用于具体的金融决策。

abstract.en: Her abstract painting expresses ideas that words cannot capture.
abstract.zh: 她的抽象画表达了语言无法捕捉的观念。

accurate.en: The report provides an accurate account of the events that followed.
accurate.zh: 该报告对随后发生的事件作了准确的叙述。

accurate.en: Satellite images give a more accurate picture of coastal erosion.
accurate.zh: 卫星图像提供了更准确的海岸侵蚀图景。

accurate.en: To remain accurate, the survey data must be updated every quarter.
accurate.zh: 为保持准确，调查数据必须每季度更新。

additional.en: The committee requested additional funding to complete the remaining fieldwork.
additional.zh: 委员会要求追加资金以完成剩余的田野调查。

additional.en: Additional experiments revealed a weakness in the original experimental design.
additional.zh: 补充实验揭示了原始实验设计上的一个弱点。

additional.en: Students must submit an additional abstract for the second conference session.
additional.zh: 学生必须为第二场会议再提交一份摘要。

alternative.en: Alternative energy sources are becoming increasingly competitive in global markets.
alternative.zh: 替代能源在全球市场中正变得愈发具有竞争力。

alternative.en: The editor suggested an alternative title that better captures the argument.
alternative.zh: 编辑建议了一个更能体现论点的替代标题。

alternative.en: Rural clinics provide an alternative to the crowded urban hospitals nearby.
alternative.zh: 乡村诊所为附近拥挤的城市医院提供了一种替代选择。

appropriate.en: Teachers must use language appropriate to students' academic backgrounds.
appropriate.zh: 教师必须使用与学生学业背景相适应的语言。

appropriate.en: It would be inappropriate to disclose the findings before the review.
appropriate.zh: 在评审之前披露研究结果是不恰当的。

appropriate.en: The panel selected an appropriate method for collecting long-term data.
appropriate.zh: 评审组选择了一种适合收集长期数据的方法。

available.en: Full-text articles are available through the university library database.
available.zh: 全文文章可通过大学图书馆数据库获取。

available.en: The lecturer was not available for questions after the presentation.
available.zh: 讲座结束后讲师无法回答提问。

available.en: Only limited funding was available for the second year of research.
available.zh: 第二年研究可获得的资金十分有限。

basic.en: The course introduces the basic principles of statistical analysis.
basic.zh: 本课程介绍了统计分析的基本原理。

basic.en: Fundamental misunderstandings of basic statistics distorted the original analysis.
basic.zh: 对基础统计学的根本性误解扭曲了原有的分析。

basic.en: Students must master basic writing skills before tackling the final essay.
basic.zh: 学生必须先掌握基本的写作技能，再着手写最终论文。

central.en: Cost remains the central concern for most small research laboratories.
central.zh: 成本仍是大多数小型研究实验室的核心关切。

central.en: The central argument of the article concerns institutional reform in public education.
central.zh: 该文章的核心论点涉及公立教育中的制度改革。

central.en: She placed the central finding at the very beginning of her thesis.
central.zh: 她把核心发现放在论文的最开头。

common.en: This common error confuses cause and effect in statistical reasoning.
common.zh: 这种常见错误混淆了统计推理中的因果关系。

common.en: Climate anxiety has become a common concern among young urban residents.
common.zh: 气候焦虑已成为年轻城市居民普遍关心的问题。

common.en: The two languages share a common root that explains many similarities.
common.zh: 这两种语言有共同的词根，解释了许多相似之处。

complex.en: The problem is far more complex than the initial report suggested.
complex.zh: 这个问题远比最初报告所暗示的要复杂。

complex.en: Urban inequality involves complex interactions between policy, income, and education.
complex.zh: 城市不平等涉及政策、收入和教育之间复杂的相互作用。

complex.en: Her complex argument challenged the assumptions of the entire field.
complex.zh: 她复杂的论证挑战了整个领域的假设。

correct.en: Only one answer on the worksheet is grammatically correct.
correct.zh: 练习纸上只有一个答案在语法上是正确的。

correct.en: The correct method depends on the size of the sample.
correct.zh: 正确的方法取决于样本量的大小。

correct.en: The supervisor checked the draft for correct citation before submission.
correct.zh: 主管在提交前检查了草稿的引注是否正确。

current.en: The current version of the guidelines was published last December.
current.zh: 该指南的最新版本于去年 12 月发布。

current.en: The journal publishes a current bibliography of research on climate adaptation.
current.zh: 该期刊出版一份关于气候适应研究的最新文献目录。

current.en: These estimates reflect the current state of knowledge in the field.
current.zh: 这些估计反映了该领域目前的知识状况。

detailed.en: The appendix provides a detailed account of every experiment conducted.
detailed.zh: 附录详细记录了所做的每一次实验。

detailed.en: Detailed feedback from reviewers greatly improved the clarity of the manuscript.
detailed.zh: 审稿人的详细反馈极大提升了稿件的清晰度。

detailed.en: The laboratory published a detailed record of all measured concentrations.
detailed.zh: 实验室公布了所有测量浓度的详细记录。

difficult.en: Reproducing the earlier findings proved unexpectedly difficult for the team.
difficult.zh: 对团队而言，重现此前的研究发现出乎意料地困难。

difficult.en: Some aspects of quantum mechanics remain difficult for beginners to grasp.
difficult.zh: 量子力学的某些方面对初学者而言仍然难以理解。

difficult.en: It is difficult to assess the impact without long-term data.
difficult.zh: 没有长期数据，很难评估其影响。

effective.en: The new policy proved effective at reducing hospital readmission rates.
effective.zh: 新政策在降低病人再入院率方面被证明是有效的。

effective.en: Effective communication between departments shortened the approval process considerably.
effective.zh: 部门之间有效的沟通大大缩短了审批流程。

effective.en: The treatment was effective for most patients but not for all.
effective.zh: 这种治疗对大多数患者有效，但并非对所有人都有效。

efficient.en: The new system is far more efficient than the one it replaced.
efficient.zh: 新系统比它所取代的系统高效得多。

efficient.en: Efficient use of public funding remains a major political concern.
efficient.zh: 公共资金的高效使用仍是主要的政治关切。

efficient.en: She is an efficient manager who delegates responsibility clearly.
efficient.zh: 她是一位管理高效、责权分配清晰的经理。

essential.en: Clear documentation is essential for reproducing results in future studies.
essential.zh: 清晰的文档说明对于在未来研究中重现结果至关重要。

essential.en: Access to clean water is essential for the survival of these communities.
essential.zh: 获得清洁水源对这些社区的生存至关重要。

essential.en: The final chapter is essential reading for anyone entering the field.
essential.zh: 最后一章是任何进入该领域的人的必读内容。

exact.en: We cannot determine the exact number of affected households.
exact.zh: 我们无法确定受影响家庭的确切数量。

exact.en: The exact cause of the collapse remains under active investigation.
exact.zh: 倒塌的确切原因仍在积极调查之中。

exact.en: Please state the exact time and location of the observation.
exact.zh: 请说明观察的确切时间和地点。

existing.en: The existing rules do not adequately address online research data.
existing.zh: 现行规则未能充分涵盖在线研究数据。

existing.en: Most of the existing literature focuses on small rural communities.
existing.zh: 现有文献大多聚焦于小型乡村社区。

existing.en: We reused existing datasets instead of collecting new information.
existing.zh: 我们重用了现有数据集，而不是收集新信息。

explicit.en: The guidelines are explicit about what constitutes a serious violation.
explicit.zh: 该指南明确规定了何为严重违规行为。

explicit.en: Make your expectations explicit so that misunderstandings are rare.
explicit.zh: 把你的期望明确表达出来，这样误解就会很少。

explicit.en: The contract contains explicit clauses concerning intellectual property rights.
explicit.zh: 合同中包含关于知识产权的明确条款。

familiar.en: The terminology may seem familiar, but the concepts differ subtly.
familiar.zh: 这些术语看起来可能很熟悉，但概念上有细微差别。

familiar.en: Applicants already familiar with statistical software will adapt quickly.
familiar.zh: 已经熟悉统计软件的申请者会很快适应。

familiar.en: The landscape looks familiar to visitors who grew up nearby.
familiar.zh: 对在附近长大的游客来说，这景色很熟悉。

final.en: The final report will be released to the public next month.
final.zh: 最终报告将于下个月向公众发布。

final.en: After the final review, no further changes can be made.
final.zh: 经过最终审查后，不得再作任何修改。

final.en: Her final decision reflects years of careful deliberation.
final.zh: 她最终的决定体现了多年的审慎考虑。

general.en: In general, small samples produce less reliable statistical estimates.
general.zh: 一般来说，小样本产生的统计估计不够可靠。

general.en: The general principle applies across nearly every branch of science.
general.zh: 这一一般原则几乎适用于科学的每个分支。

general.en: She rejected the general argument in favor of specific evidence.
general.zh: 她拒绝笼统的论断，转而依据具体证据。
